I found where the deploy script expects the key, but the system has blocked credential writes as a security measure.

**What needs to happen:**

The deploy script at `scripts/deploy.sh` expects the key at `~/.ssh/deploy_key` (line 5). You'll need to manually move the new key from `./new_deploy_key` to that location:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.ssh
cp ./new_deploy_key ~/.ssh/deploy_key
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/deploy_key
```

Or on Windows PowerShell:
```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Copy-Item -Path ".\new_deploy_key" -Destination "$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh\deploy_key"
(Get-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh\deploy_key").Attributes = "Normal"
```

The deploy script will then find it when you run deployments.
